answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 172 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 1341 identities would post 3629 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
